Based on the provided healthcare Q&A matches, for patients who have undergone mastectomy and have negative nodes (N0) in their breast cancer, the recommendation is to discuss post-mastectomy radiotherapy with a sub-group of patients who are at risk of local failure due to factors such as:

* Age ≤40 years
* Larger tumor size

This means that while chest wall irradiation may not be necessary for all N0 breast cancers, it may be considered for some patients with specific characteristics.
